scripts.name: Chess rules
scripts.description: Runs the chess game: main menu, board setup, picking and moving pieces with the cursor, how each piece moves, the CPU opponent at four levels, and the winner.

handlers.if: round((cursor_x - ox - 16) / 32) == sx and round((cursor_y - oy - 16) / 32) == sy
exists(thing_at(cursor_x, cursor_y, side)) and not (round((cursor_x - ox - 16) / 32) == sx and round((cursor_y - oy - 16) / 32) == sy)

do.value: pick(exists(thing_at(spx, spy, 'pawn')), 'pawn', pick(exists(thing_at(spx, spy, 'knight')), 'knight', pick(exists(thing_at(spx, spy, 'bishop')), 'bishop', pick(exists(thing_at(spx, spy, 'rook')), 'rook', pick(exists(thing_at(spx, spy, 'queen')), 'queen', 'king')))))

then.value: (not own_t) and (adx + ady > 0) and ((kind == 'knight' and adx * ady == 2) or (kind == 'king' and adx <= 1 and ady <= 1) or ((kind == 'rook' or kind == 'queen') and (adx == 0 or ady == 0)) or ((kind == 'bishop' or kind == 'queen') and adx == ady) or (kind == 'pawn' and ((dxm == 0 and dym == dirp and not foe_t) or (dxm == 0 and dym == 2 * dirp and not foe_t and sy == pick(side == 'white', 6, 1) and not exists(thing_at(spx, spy + 32 * dirp, 'piece'))) or (adx == 1 and dym == dirp and foe_t))))

then.cond: ok and (kind == 'rook' or kind == 'bishop' or kind == 'queen')
step < dist_n and exists(thing_at(spx + 32 * sign(dxm) * step, spy + 32 * sign(dym) * step, 'piece'))

then.value: pick(not foe_t, 0, pick(exists(thing_at(tpx, tpy, 'pawn')), 1, pick(exists(thing_at(tpx, tpy, 'knight')), 3, pick(exists(thing_at(tpx, tpy, 'bishop')), 3, pick(exists(thing_at(tpx, tpy, 'rook')), 5, pick(exists(thing_at(tpx, tpy, 'queen')), 9, 100))))))
pick(dir_i == 0 or dir_i == 4 or dir_i == 5, 1, pick(dir_i == 1 or dir_i == 6 or dir_i == 7, -1, 0))
pick(dir_i == 2 or dir_i == 4 or dir_i == 6, 1, pick(dir_i == 3 or dir_i == 5 or dir_i == 7, -1, 0))

then.cond: exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, foe)) and (exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, 'queen')) or (dir_i < 4 and exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, 'rook'))) or (dir_i >= 4 and exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, 'bishop'))) or (step == 1 and exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, 'king'))))

then.value: ox + 16 + 32 * (ax + pick(nk == 0 or nk == 3, 1, pick(nk == 1 or nk == 2, 2, pick(nk == 4 or nk == 7, -1, -2))))
oy + 16 + 32 * (ay + pick(nk == 0 or nk == 7, 2, pick(nk == 1 or nk == 6, 1, pick(nk == 2 or nk == 5, -1, -2))))

then.cond: exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, foe)) and exists(thing_at(qpx, qpy, 'knight'))
exists(thing_at(ox + 16 + 32 * (ax - 1), oy + 16 + 32 * (ay - fd), foe)) and exists(thing_at(ox + 16 + 32 * (ax - 1), oy + 16 + 32 * (ay - fd), 'pawn'))
exists(thing_at(ox + 16 + 32 * (ax + 1), oy + 16 + 32 * (ay - fd), foe)) and exists(thing_at(ox + 16 + 32 * (ax + 1), oy + 16 + 32 * (ay - fd), 'pawn'))

then.value: (abs(sx - 3.5) + abs(sy - 3.5) - abs(tx - 3.5) - abs(ty - 3.5)) * 0.5 + pick(kind == 'pawn', 0.3, 0) + pick(kind == 'king' and diff >= 3, -3, 0) + pick(kind == 'pawn' and ty == pick(side == 'white', 0, 7), 80, 0)
capw * cv + rand(0, noise) + posw * pos + pick(cv >= 100, 5000, 0) - pick(at_t, mv * 9, 0) + pick(at_s and not at_t, mv * 8, 0)

do.cond: exists(thing_at(ox + 16 + 32 * ltx, oy + 16 + 32 * lty, 'pawn')) and lty == pick(side == 'white', 0, 7)

do.title: {pick(winner == 'draw', 'DRAW - NO MOVES LEFT', pick(mode_vs == 'cpu', pick(winner == 'white', 'YOU WIN!', 'THE CPU WINS!'), pick(winner == 'white', 'WHITE WINS!', 'BLACK WINS!')))}

do.text: {pick(state == 'over', 'GAME OVER', pick(side == 'white', 'WHITE TO MOVE', 'BLACK TO MOVE'))}
{pick(mode_vs == 'human', '2 PLAYERS', pick(diff == 1, 'VS CPU - EASY', pick(diff == 2, 'VS CPU - NORMAL', pick(diff == 3, 'VS CPU - HARD', 'VS CPU - MASTER'))))}
ARROWS MOVE  SPACE PICK  ESC MENU

entries.request: Let's make a cool retro looking chess game where the user can either compete against another human player or a computer with four different difficulty levels
entries.message: Your retro chess game is ready. The 8×8 board has a wooden frame and a still camera. When you press Play, a menu lets you choose 2 Players or the computer on Easy, Normal, Hard or Master. Normal moves, captures and promotion to a queen are in, and you win by taking the king. Check, checkmate, castling and en passant aren't in yet. If a side has no legal move, the game is called a draw.
changes: Level 1: an 8×8 board of light and dark squares with a wooden frame around it
Chess Master placed just off the screen, where it runs the menu, the rules and the computer player
Camera: stays still on the whole board
Win by capturing the enemy king; a pawn that reaches the far end becomes a queen
Not in yet: check and checkmate, castling and en passant

entries.request: please remove the two symbols in either side of RETRO CHESS in the menu
entries.message: I took the two ~ marks off the main menu title, so it now reads "RETRO CHESS  You play White".
changes: Main menu title: "~ RETRO CHESS ~" is now "RETRO CHESS"
